_comment: Hoodrich dealers -- the people you buy BULK from. Bulk cannot be sold until it has been
bagged up at the kitchen counter in the stash house.
Only the dock worker lives here. Buying off a gang is done by walking up to their leader
and asking him, so there is no second layer of corner dealers standing around doing the
same job. Independent suppliers for the other products come back later.
THE PROGRESSION: Gerald is where you start. Once you have moved enough weight
(Economy > DocksUnlockGrams in Hoodrich.ini, default 50g) he names the port, which is
what makes the dock worker -- and with him the whole catalogue at the best price -- exist
for you. Call him from the wheel and he drives out to you.
drugs            what they sell. EMPTY means the whole catalogue -- that is the docks.
zones            GET_NAME_OF_ZONE codes they stand in
models           ped models tried IN ORDER; first one present in your install wins
priceMultiplier  applied to the wholesale price. Below 1.0 is a better deal.
openHour/closeHour  operating hours, 0-24. Wraps midnight when open > close.
greeting / buyLine / sourceReply / sourceTooSoon / farewell  what they say to you

dealers.name: Tao Cheng
dealers._zones: Tao stood on a different corner of the docks every time you drove in. He has a fixed spot now (the port meeting) and a phone number, so the roaming marker is gone. An empty zone list is the switch: he stays defined, nothing that refers to him by id breaks, and he never matches a zone again.
dealers.greeting: Gerald's people. Gerald's. Yeah. Keep it quiet, keep it quick, and whatever's in the box -- I get it off the box. That's the. that's the whole business, right there.
dealers.buyLine: Bricks. I deal in bricks, nothing smaller, dont ask. So say what, and say how many. In that order please.
dealers.sourceReply: Where do I get it. Where do I -- man. I AM where you get it. I'm the. yeah. me.
dealers.farewell: Go on. Go. And dont come back in daylight if youre carryin, thats. thats just manners.
dealers.openingText: my friend. my FRIEND. you did that for gerald so now you do it for you. say where you are and what you want and i drive it to you myself. bricks only tho. dont ask me for grams, thats. thats insulting
dealers.textCalled: yeah yeah im comin. give me a. give me a minute
dealers.textLeaving: leaving now. dont go anywhere. im leaving NOW
dealers.textOutside: im outside. im outside your. im here. come out

dealers.name: Gerald
dealers._rides: A green Blazer, because he comes four streets with a bag rather than making a delivery. blazer and blazer2 are the quad; blazer3 is the Lost's and blazer5 is the hovercraft, which would both be wrong.
dealers.greeting: You called, I came. That's the last thing that comes free. What you need.
dealers.buyLine: I ain't the port and I ain't a warehouse. Weed, pills, bars. Say what, say how much.
dealers.sourceReply: Where I get it ain't your business yet. Move enough of mine and it'll be your business.
dealers.farewell: Aight. And next time, have somethin' worth callin' me about.
dealers.openingText: heard you workin now. weed, pills, bars -- thats what i move. dont ask me for bricks, thats a different conversation
dealers.textCalled: on my way. and im timin it
dealers.textLeaving: leavin now. be outside when i get there. i dont wait on nobody
dealers.textOutside: im outside. come out. clock's runnin
